pitch_hz.unit: Hz; base oscillator, not dominant spectral peak

decay.unit: normalized; amplitude tau 15 ms to 2.4 s

color.unit: normalized; A tuning and related carrier ratios

shape.unit: normalized; PM depth, bounded feedback and readout density

sweep.unit: normalized; B tuning, not a pitch sweep

punch.unit: normalized; onset speed and early amplitude emphasis

drive.unit: normalized; squared nonlinear blend, neutral zero

gate.unit: boolean; rising edge triggers, falling edge does not choke

choke.unit: boolean; rising edge starts 8 ms fade; onset has simultaneous-event priority

lifecycle: All musical controls and velocity latch at onset. Gate and choke are events. Persistent state; no sleep optimization. New onset restarts oscillator phases/envelopes, not fixed filter state. Choke release cannot revive a tail.
